_comment: GATE RUN. One client, so there is no aggregation at all: the server sums one weighted update and the client divides by the same total, which is the identity. What is left is exactly the pieces every other run shares - the pretrained backbone, the transform, the head, the learning rate. If the head does not learn HERE, nothing measured in a federated run says anything about aggregation. Separate base paths from every other config on purpose: these rows must never reach the real results CSV, and must never deduplicate against it. early_stop_patience is effectively disabled so the whole trajectory is visible.
